one_month_reasoning: No scheduled earnings in the 2026-10-02 to 2026-11-01 window: H1 results came out 2026-09-15 (stock fell ~5.6% on later-than-hoped post-quantum revenue), and full-year results are normally reported in early spring. Possible unscheduled items: a Q3 business/metrics update or PQC certification news (CC EAL5+/FIPS 140-3/TCG were guided 'through Q4 2026'). These are not dated and could go either way. Alternative signals are neutral. Short interest is falling (12.05M on Aug 14, 10.96M on Sep 15, ~2.2 days to cover) and the squeeze model rates it 'low', so there is no squeeze setup. Borrow costs ~15%. Retail quantum sentiment is cooling. Insiders have sold small amounts with no buys. Cash of about $2.1/share sits just under the price and should soften the downside. So I use a near-symmetric lognormal around $2.41 with monthly sigma ~0.28 (100% annual vol / 3.5) and slightly more mass held above $1.94 because of the cash floor.

fair_value.method: 50/50 blend of (a) cash-adjusted EV/sales: 4x an estimated FY2027 revenue of $45M = $180M EV, plus ~$430M forward net cash and investments, over ~235M share-equivalents = $2.60; and (b) a sum of the parts that haircuts cash for burn and control/governance discount: $2.30. Net cash (~$495M liquidity vs ~$542M market cap) dominates the value.

bear.story: PQC certifications or production slip into 2028 and FY2026 lands at the low end (~$27M). Burn continues and cash keeps flowing into acquisitions and sovereign fab/quantum investments. Quantum sentiment keeps fading, and the stock trades at a 20-30% discount to shrinking net cash (~$1.85/sh).

base.story: FY2026 ~$30M, and FY2027 ~$40-50M with first QS7001/QVault TPM production revenue. Burn holds at ~$60M/yr. The stock trades around cash plus a modest value for the operating business.

bull.story: Certifications land in Q4 2026 to Q1 2027 and named design wins (TPM/IoT/defense) convert pipeline. Revenue clearly exceeds $50M in 2027, and a quantum/PQC narrative rally (regulatory PQC deadlines, quantum hardware headlines) re-rates the stock back toward the 2025-26 highs, as it has done before (52w high $8.71).

thesis_break_reason: At ~$1.40 the market cap (~$320M) would be ~35% below current liquidity and ~25% below my forward net cash. That would most likely mean something fundamental: a large cash-consuming acquisition or write-down of the quantum/fab investments, a much faster burn, a governance problem at the WISeKey-controlled structure, or abandonment of the PQC product roadmap. Ordinary volatility alone would not take it there.

reasoning: The stock is a hype-cycle quantum/PQC name that has de-rated to roughly its cash. At $2.425 the market cap is ~$542M on 223.4M ordinary shares (~$560M including F-share equivalents), against ~$495M of liquidity and almost no debt, so the enterprise value is only ~$50-65M for a business guiding $27-36M of 2026 revenue at ~48% gross margin. That is the core fact, and it anchors the distribution: cash gives a soft floor, and history shows the stock can trade below it (52w low $1.99) because burn (~$60M/yr EBITDA loss), heavy G&A, constant acquisitions/investments and WISeKey control justify a discount. Alternative-lane signals are neutral to slightly negative. Short interest fell for four straight settlements to ~11M shares (~2.2 days to cover), and the squeeze risk is rated low. Borrow costs ~15%, which is elevated but not extreme. Insiders sold ~$115k over 3 months with no buys. Retail quantum enthusiasm is cooling, with peers down YTD, although Stocktwits polls are still bullish. Prediction markets put a cryptographically relevant quantum computer as unlikely before 2027 (Kalshi ~7% before 2027 per secondary report; Manifold 15% for an RSA break by 2030, a thin market of 10 holders), so no 'Q-day' panic catalyst is likely inside the horizon. PQC demand will be driven by compliance deadlines rather than by an imminent threat. I could not fetch X/Twitter, Kalshi (HTTP 429), Google Trends or job-posting data, so the alternative-data coverage is limited. Fair value is ~$2.45, a blend of EV/sales at $2.60 and a haircut SOTP at $2.30, so I set the median slightly below spot (~$2.30) for burn and dilution. The right tail is fat because the name re-rates violently on quantum news (52w high $8.71), giving ~25% for the bull case near $5. The left tail is compressed relative to a pure 100%-vol lognormal by the cash backing; I put ~18% below $1.46 and ~5% below $0.97. Scenario-weighted mean is ~$2.78 against a median of ~$2.30.
